## CRIS QA - Safe Conversation Cleanup

Webhook: POST /cris-safe-conversation-cleanup

Default: dry_run=true.
Real cleanup requires confirm=DELETE_QA_CONVERSATIONS.

Allowed phones only:
- 0998299109
- 21999910781

Targets by allowlisted phone and lead/conversation UUID only; quicklink_id is not globally unique. Preserves leads_quicklink and resets them to PENDIENTE; deletes derived conversation/runtime state.
